CortexProbe pipeline

Prepare matched frames. Fit a field. Test predictions.

Prepare matched frames

  1. Build masks

    Bar · wedge · ring

    Group + prune frames.

  2. Create responses

    Gaussian overlap × amplitude + baseline

    Optional seeded noise.

  3. Align inputs

    One mask, response + group per retained frame

    Check shapes + bounds.

Same inputs · separate fits

Estimate the field

Use all retained frames

  1. Search candidates

    Center + width grid

  2. Refine the fit

    SciPy refinement within bounds

    Solve amplitude + baseline at every candidate and trial geometry.

  3. Field estimate + checks

    Center (x, y), width,
    amplitude + baseline

    In-sample R² · local uncertainty · residual checks

Test predictions

Repeat for each usable group

  1. Hold out one group

    Train on the other groups. Keep held-out data separate.

  2. Fit training frames

    Candidate grid → bounded refinement.

    Solve amplitude + baseline at every candidate and trial geometry.

  3. Predict held-out frames

    Keep all five parameters fixed.

    Held-out masks → prediction

  4. Score predictions

    Held-out responses → scoring only.

    Mean + sample SD of finite fold R².

The all-frame fit does not initialize validation fits.

Held-out scores do not determine acceptance.

Examples and recorded results are synthetic. No human-data or neural-network evaluation.
